data.name: contentquality guards
data.description: Shared helpers for prompt leak detection, English spacing normalization, paragraph/word counts, and generic reading question detection.
Shared IELTS profile parser now feeds listening prompt controls and reading metadata inference.

data.name: reading shape validation
data.description: Reading generation applies question-type defaults and validates structures before returning content to service layer.
Reading fallback and audio retry now converge in service layer: failed generation falls back to structured content; failed audio can resume via RetryReadingAudio.
Run go test ./internal/service -run TestSmallSampleQualityGate -v before any IELTS batch expansion.
